Semantic changes reopen affected answers and final confirmation while preserving unrelated answers; formatting-only changes preserve confirmation. Semantic identity covers goal, scope, exclusions, dependencies, acceptance, validation and required plugin policy.

Project defaults permit explicit temporary per-run overrides. The effective configuration is recorded and frozen across resume; persistent edits are explicit and never silently satisfy or replace parked-run obligations.

Recommended bundles require bounded comparison evidence in the target workflow. Untested or compatibility-only candidates remain manually selectable with explicit evidence status; no eligible candidate produces an explicit empty recommendation set.

The installation proposal displays exact versions, hook locations, enabled state and readiness effects. Actual confirmation installs and enables exactly the displayed configuration; skill execution occurs later in authorized workflows.
